name: Isaxonine

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in France, first in 1983 — for liver harm

summary: Isaxonine was pulled from the market in France, first in 1983, due to liver harm [3]. In addition, a small computer model evaluated the drug rather than tests on people [M]. This computer model gave the drug a low score of 34 for liver harm and a low score of 15 for heart harm [M].
